item.title: Psalm 18: The Lord Our Rock, Fortress, and Faithful Deliverer
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 18 and explains how the Lord reveals Himself as our rock, fortress, shield, and mighty deliverer. David’s testimony of rescue points forward to Christ, the greater King and Savior. This passage encourages believers to trust God’s strength in every trial and to praise Him for His faithful deliverance.

item.title: When God Feels Silent: Trusting Him in Seasons of Suffering
item.description: There are seasons in the Christian life when God feels near—and seasons when He feels painfully silent. In this episode of Anchored in the Word, Dave Jenkins helps Christians think biblically about suffering when God feels silent and points listeners to hope in Christ.

item.title: How the Hope of Christ Strengthens Families
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how the hope of Christ strengthens families by anchoring them in God’s promises, bringing peace in trials, producing endurance in hardship, uniting the home in love, and filling families with lasting joy. Key text: Romans 15:13.
